name: Woodcock Collision Estimation with Octree Acceleration
aliases: Woodcock Collision Estimation with Octree Acceleration (Fast)
definition: An optimized ray marching method that combines Woodcock collision estimation with an octree traversal to skip empty regions and nodes that do not intersect the ray's current segment, reducing the number of volume samples.
summary: An optimized ray marching method that combines Woodcock collision estimation with octree traversal to skip empty regions, differing from standard ray marching by using the octree to cull non-intersecting nodes.
